page_title: INT 2-0 LEC | Inter v Lecce 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Nicolo Barella leaves the pitch and is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
89' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davy Klaassen (Inter) replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) coming on for Remi Oudin.
86' The substitution has been made. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) has replaced Valentin Gendrey.
84' Substitution. Alexis Sanchez (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Marcus Thuram walks off.
84' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Carlos Augusto is replaced by Benjamin Pavard (Inter).

84' What is going on? At first it seemed that Lameck Banda (Lecce) would get away without any booking, then all of a sudden Matteo Marcenaro pulls out a red card! Lameck Banda (Lecce) must have said something really inappropriate! He is sent off!
82' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kristjan Asllani (Inter). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
82' The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
81' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Now Inter have a corner.
78' 2 - 0 Nicolo Barella (Inter) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hakan Calhanoglu departs the field of play to be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
74' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) is penalised.
73' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Roberto Piccoli and he is replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce).
70' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
69' The ball possession is 69:31.
64' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza is given a rest as he is replaced by Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
64' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is booked.
60' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
58' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
53' Inter have a corner.
51' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Lecce! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Matteo Marcenaro and both teams have no complaints.
51' Surely that's handball by one of the Inter players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
48' None of the Inter players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Roberto D'Aversa probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Joan Gonzalez (Lecce). He is replaced by Mohamed Kaba.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' 1 - 0 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Yann Bisseck (Inter) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header inside the right post. An incredible long-range header!
41' A cross from a corner kick by Inter is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
41' The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' Lameck Banda (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul. Inter are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
38' Lameck Banda (Lecce) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
35' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
33' The ratio of the ball possession is 73:27.
31' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
30' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
28' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

26' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lameck Banda (Lecce) who sends his header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
23' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

22' What a huge chance for Marko Arnautovic (Inter). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
21' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
19' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
18' A pass from Carlos Augusto (Inter) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
17' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
15' Inter get a corner.

15' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Marko Arnautovic (Inter). Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
13' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.

11' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
10' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

9' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Yann Sommer easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.
9' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Inter as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
3' There's a break in play and referee Matteo Marcenaro must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Inter using VAR. This could be interesting!
3' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
1' Lameck Banda (Lecce) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
